fusions.name: Venom Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a bolt at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage and making it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Patient Fang
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and makes the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed Skin
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Venom Wake
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% poison resistance for as long as you carry it.
